headline: Escrow Record: Delivery Timing, Release Objection Terms, and Separate Breach Allegation
document_kind: Escrow record and administrative correspondence excerpts
preview: The supplied record identifies North Company and South Company and states that delivery is due at the end of a Relevant Period, defined as ending March 15, 2031. It does not say what must be delivered, to whom, or by what method. A separate term states an escrow release amount of $77,777 and requires a release objection within forty-five days, while preserving a fraud objection afterward. The text does not identify the event that starts the forty-five-day period, who must submit an objection, or how objections are handled. A further section reports that South Company alleges breach by North Company, but says the correspondence does not report a judicial finding of breach. This allegation is not an adjudicated finding. Repeated administrative-background text is described as adding no operative terms.

key_points.text: North Company and South Company are identified as parties; delivery is due at the end of a Relevant Period ending March 15, 2031. The delivery item, recipient, and method are unspecified.

The stated escrow release amount is $77,777. A release objection is due within forty-five days, with a fraud-objection exception afterward; the triggering event and responsible party are not identified.
